eras.label: current
eras.note: Converted the House of Delegates from 67 multi-member districts to 100 single-member districts, per a 2018 law mandating the switch. Veto override on ordinary bills is only a majority of elected members — lower than the typical 2/3; budget/appropriations bills require 2/3 (67 seats) instead.
